# Every exchange

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
autonumber
participant C as Client
actor O as Operator
C->>S: solid
S-->>C: dotted
C->S: open
S-->C: dotted open
C-xS: cross
S--xC: dotted cross
C-)S: async
S--)C: dotted async
C<<->>S: both
S<<-->>C: dotted both
Note left of C: left
Note right of S: right
Note over C,O: over
loop poll
C->>S: ping
end
alt healthy
S-->>C: pong
else sick
S-->>O: page
end
opt verbose
S->>S: log
end
par primary
S->>C: one
and secondary
S->>O: two
end
critical commit
S->>S: write
option rollback
S->>S: undo
end
break abort
O->>S: stop
end
rect rgb(1,2,3)
C->>S: highlighted
end
```
